_about: What Word 16.106 drew for tools/make_hide_mark_probe.py: every text object (as render-observations.json records them), each case's row distances as Word drew them (the bottom row's and the After line's baseline below the top row's, px), the renderer's scores against them -- cases per family, lines within half a pixel, the glyph row -- and every face number the renderer asked for. Measurements only; regenerate with tools/read_hide_mark_probe.py --record.
